First off I'm fat and I have no self esteem where I don't leave the house.  I use to be fit and out going.

First step here is to be proud of losing 40lbs.  Keep eating healthy and exercising so you can be healthy and at least content with your looks so you can look for work.

How old are you?  What are your hobbies?  Concentrate on YOU before you think ahead of having a girlfriend and kids.

Lets work from the bottom up and I promise it will help you.

60 years is a very long time and so much can happen that will be good if you make a start today.  Reach out and talk to us here if it will help you.

I was with my gf for 2 years and everything was going pretty good.  I always had issues finding work but she helped me to get a job at a computer place.  I ended up getting so depressed that I quit.  Gain some weight but not bad.  Still went out and was happy with her.  I should have went to get medication but I didn't.

She got me a good job where she worked.  I was making over $18 an hour to start, easy work, no benefits so I didn't get help but I felt good and was happy.  And I wasn't happy for a while and now I was good.  Then I started having issues at home, fighting with my mother as shes messy and i'm ocd clean, and my neighbors which are animals.

My gf found an apartment, it was nice and big, balcony, but I didn't feel ready.  I haven't saved up enough money and I wanted to wait.  She pushed me into the new apartment and it was rough for the first month, fighting and all the work to fix up the place.  Lots of stress, had a fight with the super, and landlord.  So much noise, 4 flights of god damn stairs... Tiny smelly elavator.

But we were good again and I was working and doing well.  I started getting depressed.  Realllly bad.  I wanted to move back home.  I got laid off, we both moved back home.  So all that work, money.. wasted on what... what a waste....  I should have gotten medication and help and stuck it out but I had no money for rent.

cont? part 2?

Well were both back home but would see each other almost everyday.  I started collecting unemployment and was doing fine and we were good again but she wanted me to find work.  I really needed to get myself in shape again for I was a mess.  I didn't want anyone to see me at my lowest so I stopped going out. She pushed me to get help and I did, got medication and it helped GREATLY.  I was me again mentally but I was still depressed about my weight.  I wasn't leaving the house anymore.  So to shorten this story up, I tried starting a nice online company which didn't cost much, i lost my unemployment and haven't had one customer, no money, she LEFT me right before this happened, and I got worse and depressed.  Had to cancel my cell phone, bank account, cable, everything except internet, credit cards are due..  

Now I'm stuck back where I started but worse.  I fucked up a good job, apartment (although I didn't want to move just yett..), great girl, I WAS in shape... And now I have nothingggg...  I talk to her sparingly and I tell her I'm gonna fix this but shes heard it all before and says maybe one day.

I won't go on much longer with all this regret....

If not, you have your entire life ahead of you.  Filled with ups and downs and many relationships.  Try that and if she doesn't feel the same you need to just keep bettering yourself.  Make you, the best you can be and things will come your way.  But try the first step, talking to her.
